says: A surface said in this observatory: the steps one can take from what is shown - each thing a line is about, once, with how to stand on it. For a shell, for a script, for anyone who walks by saying where to stand.
What is being done now, what is in progress, and what shows and has come to nothing yet: three lenses placed together, asking nothing of their own.

What this observatory shows first: what followed the latest thing the author said; then its own sheet - what is showing and what each waits on - then the perfect form of the whole and how the whole stands to it, then every other lens in view.

The pages this observatory publishes: the whole; a page for each place it has in view, each sign, each angle of the perfect form, each decision a sign came to, and each record of work of the last three days with each thing it entered or changed - what the thing says in full, and what is around it - and the pages the places in view offer of their own. Each row is a page: where it is written, what it looks through, and the thing it is the page of.

What is still showing, and what the whole waits on: signs nothing has come of, runs failing on main, what holds work back and by what, what waits only in words, and what would free the most once done - placed together, asking nothing of their own.
